# Riyas V. A.

> Official website of Riyas V. A., Chairman & Managing Director of the Atlas–Maharani Group, a fashion, wedding and lifestyle retail group based in Thodupuzha, Kerala, India, with 25 shops across Kerala and a team of more than 400 people.

## Key facts

- Name: Riyas V. A. (also written Riyas VA)
- Role: Chairman & Managing Director, Atlas–Maharani Group
- Location: Thodupuzha, Idukki district, Kerala, India
- Flagship: Maharani Wedding Collections, Thodupuzha, Kerala's largest bridal showroom (65,000 sq ft), premium bridal silk
- Brands: Maharani Wedding Collections, Atlas Fashion, @less Fashion, @less GO, Megamart, Liza Fashions
- Recognition: Times Business Awards Kerala 2026 (Spirit of Excellence, Maharani Wedding Collections); News18 Kerala Malayali of the Year; Guinness World Records, World's Largest Saree Pookkalam; Businessman of the Year
- Contact: contact@riyasva.com

- [Home](https://riyasva.com/): profile, brands, journey, awards, media, FAQ and contact
- [Press kit](https://riyasva.com/press): approved biography, key facts, downloadable portrait and photographs
